text.librispeech/4350-9170-0037: The Universal Military Service, it comes to pass that men, after making every sacrifice to get rid of the cruelty of strife and the insecurity of existence, are called upon to face all the perils they had meant to avoid.
text.librispeech/8188-274364-0011: Your Majesty having tried the affections of your people, you are absolved and loose from all rules of government, and may do what power will admit.
